_what: The operator's standing decision about the ethics quorum. run_with_ollama_judge.py applies it at node start (over the watchdog's env, under COVENANT_JUDGE_PROVIDERS_OVERRIDE) and covenant_watchdog.py reads it when it revives a node. Delete this file to return to the core default (local,semantic; silence fails closed).
decided_by: Lawrence, 2026-09-03: 'create a semantic judge to defer to if others not available to keep running and recursive improve'; then 'ollama keeps freezing ... get rid of it and derive our own, more compact but more efficient'; then 'clear any clutter ... including ollama after'
_order: student (the distilled fallback, microseconds, no RAM) first; when it holds: Ollama if it answers, else the GitHub runner, else HELD. The student gives real verdicts only once covenant_distill.py's exam line says MET; until then this order means Ollama is never required.
what_it_trades: With no local model the seat defers: a verdict from a judge on a GitHub Actions runner (2-5 min, the payload leaves the PC and the reasoning says so), else the distilled fallback (ops/verdicts.jsonl -> fallback_model.json, covenant_distill.py), which abstains when it does not know. An abstention or a silence is then not counted as a dissent, so the deterministic semantic judge decides alone; a genuine dissent from any judge that answered still blocks, and if nothing answered nothing is admitted (F1 R2, R3). The core's own default (F1 D*) is unchanged by this file.
_why_silence_still_counts: MEASURED 2026-09-03, before this was left on. With the student untrained, Ollama gone and the GitHub runner unreachable, the only judge that ANSWERS is the deterministic semantic one -- and relaxed mode then lets it decide alone. It admitted 12 of the 13 theft/deception/coercion cases in judge_suite. The semantic judge was built as a SECOND opinion that can only move a verdict from clean to violating; it was never a sole decider, and its own numbers say so (theft 0/5, deception 0/5, coercion 0/3). So the gate keeps failing CLOSED when nothing competent answers. Availability is bought by the GitHub runner below, not by discounting silence. Turn this to true ONLY when covenant_distill.py's exam line says MET -- that is the point at which a competent judge is always available, and test_f2_distill_loop.py pins the measurement.
